input: The fixed previous question is included in response instructions; canonical mono PCM16 16 kHz WAV is resampled to StepFun production PCM16 24 kHz and sent with the existing adapter appendAudioMessages/commitInputTurn path. No user input_text is sent; user.transcript.final must come from StepFun ASR.
response_rule: Capture the first completed response transcript and trim surrounding whitespace only.
repeat_command: bash scripts/codex-node.sh npm run benchmark:next-question -- --cases C01,C02,C03,C04,C05,C06,C07,C08,C09,C10 --variants A,B,C --runs 3
verification: Each sample starts a fresh StepFun websocket.
All variants reuse the same in-memory canonical WAV bytes per case.
User ASR is provider-generated after input_audio_buffer.commit.
Exactly one response.create is sent after the ASR final and Coach path.
B constrains both retrieval paths off.
C uses the production RealtimeCoachPipeline and current Retriever/Era clients.
judge_retry_policy: Retry only truncated output, network/request failures, timeouts, or HTTP 5xx; retain every attempt and use the latest complete Step 5 response.
judge_retry_policy_note: Two user-requested one-shot retry rounds; all prior attempts retained and scoring settings unchanged.
